Resource Profile: Patient: EE VRIS Child

Official URL: https://fhir.ee/vris/StructureDefinition/ee-vris-patient-child Version: 0.1.0
Draft as of 2026-08-26 Computable Name: EEVRISPatientChild

Child born from VRIS fertility treatment. (ee VRIS viljatusravi tulemusena sündinud laps. ISIKUKOOD teada!)

Usages:

  • Refer to this Profile: Condition: EE VRIS Cause of Death, Condition: EE VRIS Birth Defect, Encounter: EE VRIS Encounter, EpisodeOfCare: EE VRIS Episode of Care... Show 3 more, Observation: EE VRIS Birth Weight, Observation: EE VRIS Neonatal Intensive Care and Patient: EE VRIS Child
  • Examples for this Profile: Patient/patientChild1

You can also check for usages in the FHIR IG Statistics
